subject: Multiple dataframe elements in a barplot (beginners question)

messages.subject: Multiple dataframe elements in a barplot (beginners question)
parts:
Hey everyone,

Is there an easy solution to create a barplot with different elements
from a dataframe? For example:

Case IPP Solution
AA jes no
BB no jes
CC jes no

Now when I use: qplot(Case,IPP,data=totaal,geom="bar"). But this only
gives an incorrect barplot of the data. When I use NA to replace the
"no" answers (i'm only interested in the possitive answers) it still
displays these. Besides this only one variable is taken into account,
when I want a grouped barplot (by Case) of the variables IPP an
Solution.

Can someone help me?

Kind regards,

John

messages.subject: Re: Multiple dataframe elements in a barplot (beginners question)
parts:
> Is there an easy solution to create a barplot with different elements
> from a dataframe? For example:
>
> Case       IPP          Solution
> AA          jes           no
> BB          no            jes
> CC          jes           no
>
> Now when I use: qplot(Case,IPP,data=totaal,geom="bar"). But this only
> gives an incorrect barplot of the data. When I use NA to replace the
> "no" answers (i'm only interested in the possitive answers) it still
> displays these. Besides this only one variable is taken into account,
> when I want a grouped barplot (by Case) of the variables IPP an
> Solution.

Maybe you want:

qplot(Case, fill = IPP,data=totaal,geom="bar")
# or
qplot(Case, data=totaal,geom="bar", facets = ~ IPP)
